ahead-of-best: Ahead of your best by {{seconds}} s
clear-description: Your runs and best scores stay. The next attempt on a passage has no second caret until you set a new best.
section-body: Your best run on each passage is kept as a pace curve so you can race it. It holds positions only, not what you typed.
switch-hint: Show a second caret that types at the pace of your best run on the passage.
